newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - March 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - March 7.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Friday:
WASHINGTON - Lockheed Martin's $17 billion anti-missile missile, its future already clouded by three failures, missed its target in a fourth test.
WASHINGTON - A federal judge awarded franchises of Meineke Muffler Discount Shops Inc. $601 million in damages in the largest judgment ever in a class-action lawsuit involving franchises.

WASHINGTON - A battle to create the nation's biggest thrift institution broke out in California, with a merger contest demonstrating that the savings and loan industry has come back from the brink of disaster.
WASHINGTON - Over the next three months, 23 seniors at a local high school will take special courses to prepare them to become computer network administrators.
